name: Structured Command
description: Pass JSON input to a fixed Python program as data, with explicit known-failure routing and bounded pre-effect retries.
abilities: Freeze typed command arguments without shell interpolation
Inspect a retained outcome and branch on known failure
Retry only adapter-established safe pre-effect failures
permissions: Requires a paired Runner 2.10.0 or newer and Python 3
Review the exact computer, program and argument prefix
No model calls; no automatic repair or publishing

changes.notes: Initial structured-argument, known-failure and safe-retry walkthrough.
